name: Hangzhou Fortune Gas Cryogenic Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Fortune Gas Cryogenic Group Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacturing and sales of cryogenic equipment. It offers air separation equipment, natural gas processing and liquefaction units, and hydrogen synthesis gas equipment. The company also provides air separation units, and liquid air separation unit; rare gases, such as krypton/xenon, helium/neon, and helium extraction and liquefaction; and coil-wound heat exchanger, cold box, vacuum cryogenic storage tank, and vaporizer, as well as is involved in the operation and service of industrial gases.
